name: Planovin Business
author: devitorco

sections.description:
Planovin Business is the official WordPress plugin for connecting your site to the Planovin booking platform.

Add the Planovin widget in Elementor, set your business ID once in the admin settings, and display booking calendars, staff selection, carts, and reservation flows on your pages.

Features

  • Elementor widget for Planovin booking components
  • Simple admin page for your Planovin business ID
  • Display modes: calendar or list
  • Optional filters: service, staff/resource, category, booking ID
  • Cart, language, timezone, and theme options
  • Loads Planovin scripts only on pages that use the widget

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or later
  • PHP 7.4 or later
  • Elementor (free)

External services

This plugin connects to the Planovin platform in order to render booking widgets.

  • Service: Planovin
  • Script URL: https://plugin.planovin.com/planovin-component-starter.js
  • Website: https://planovin.com/
  • Privacy policy: https://planovin.com/privacy-policy/

When a page that includes the Planovin widget is viewed, the visitor’s browser loads the Planovin JavaScript module. Booking interactions (such as selecting a time or submitting a reservation) are processed by Planovin according to their terms and privacy policy. The plugin itself only stores your business ID in the WordPress options table.

A Planovin account is required to use the service.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the planovin-business folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate Planovin Business through the Plugins menu.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and active.
  4. Go to Planovin in the admin menu and enter your business ID.
  5. Edit a page with Elementor, add the Planovin widget, configure display options, and publish.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. The booking UI is provided as an Elementor widget.

Do I need a Planovin account?

Yes. You need an active Planovin account and business ID.

Does the plugin send data to third parties?

The plugin stores only your business ID in WordPress. On pages that use the widget, the browser loads Planovin’s official script from plugin.planovin.com. Visitor booking activity is handled by Planovin. See the “External services” section above.

Where do I find my business ID?

Log in to your Planovin dashboard. Your business ID is shown in account / business settings.

Can I use this without Elementor?

Not in this version. Elementor is required.
